questions.0.explain.t: The model proposes the call; whoever executes and decides is your code.

questions.0.options.0.t: The model asking for a function to be executed with structured arguments, which the system executes

questions.0.options.1.t: The model executing code on its own on the GPU

questions.1.explain.t: Treating the model's output as untrusted input prevents dangerous commands or queries.

questions.1.options.0.t: Because they may be malformed or the result of injection

questions.1.options.1.t: Because the model never makes mistakes

questions.1.options.2.t: Because the tool charges per argument

questions.1.q.t: Why validate the arguments the model generates for a tool?

questions.2.explain.t: Irreversible actions or those with external effect deserve an approval step.

questions.2.options.0.t: Sending emails, deleting data or making payments

questions.2.q.t: Which action should require human confirmation?
